idea-plugin.name: Claude Brains
idea-plugin.description:
Claude Code for JetBrains IDEs (unofficial). Runs Anthropic's official claude CLI inside PhpStorm and other IntelliJ IDEs, wired to the editor through the same IDE-MCP bridge the VS Code extension uses. Opens in a right-side tool window. Requires the claude CLI installed and logged in — does not bundle or redistribute Anthropic code. Not affiliated with Anthropic or JetBrains.

Current limitations — read before installing

  • Dark UI only — the panel does not follow light IDE themes yet.
  • Login is terminal-only — run claude in a terminal and sign in there first; there is no in-IDE login flow.
  • No settings page — the claude binary is resolved from PATH (or the -Dclaude.executable JVM option); nothing is configurable in the IDE yet.
  • Few slash commands — only the verified set is enabled (/compact, /clear); the rest are hidden rather than half-working. Model, mode and effort have dedicated controls in the composer instead.
  • Diffs live in the chat — changes are reviewed as line-numbered diffs inside the permission card, not in IDE diff tabs.
  • One conversation at a time — full history with resume and replay exists, tabs don't.
  • No auto-context from the editor — the current selection isn't attached automatically; use @-file mentions or paste.
